text:
raj_vendor_ops: FYI received a partial hold from AirBridge — customs flagged additional invoice details for a shipment of 80 H100s to FRA depot, they placed 40/80 on hold. AWB: 234-AB12345678. Vendor says clearance docs missing HS codes and importer VAT.

dan_procurement: Do we have the commercial invoices with HS codes? If not, what's realistic lead time to clear vs reroute to another EU hub?

jessica_logistics: Pulling docs now. If we reroute to AMS we can clear in ~48h but theres an extra route fee (~$12k) and reconsignment admin. AMS option avoids the FRA customs backlog. :thinking_face:

maria_ops: We need those 40 for next week's capacity bump. 48h is risky. Any faster RMA/express option or loaner pool while this clears?

raj_vendor_ops: Vendor offered to air-express 20 replacement units from their EU stock (shipments with PI and EU-origin paperwork, no FRA clearance risk). They require prepayment and PO amendment. I asked for a written quote — awaiting.

dan_procurement: Please paste the quote when you have it. Also check whether we can reassign 20 units from the APAC allocation scheduled for late April — that would reduce risk but may impact APAC commitments.

raj_vendor_ops: Quote (vendor):
```
air-express surcharge: $670/unit
expedite handling: $1500 flat per AWB
insurance (optional): $120/AWB
estimated ship ETA: 24-36h after PO confirmation
```
Will send amended pro forma once we confirm counts.

maria_ops: Approve 20 air-express replacements now. For the remaining 20 held units, open an RMA flow and schedule depot-local repair/clearance. Also request temporary loaner GPUs (10 units) from the EU loaner pool for 3 days to cover the expansion window.

rma_bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-20260315-8912 for 40 units (partial hold). Status: action required — docs requested. Link: https://rma.redwood.internal/RMA-20260315-8912

jessica_logistics: Confirmed loaner availability: EU pool has 8 loaners free for the requested window. We can relocate up to 4 additional loaners from the US, but that adds cross-border handling and an extra customs pre-clear fee (~$900). My recommendation: accept 8 EU loaners + 20 air-express replacements.

dan_procurement: I'll route PO amendment for the 20 express units and approve cross-charge to infra ops for loaner fees. @finance we'll need the updated invoice to post to the correct cost center.

raj_vendor_ops: Sending amended pro forma in a sec. Also flag: manifests show several serials with legacy SKU tags — depot warned they may reject on mismatch. Please have SRE confirm serial->SKU mapping to avoid another hold.

maria_ops: Noted. @sre_team can you prioritize the mapping job first thing tomorrow morning so the depot has correct manifests?

sre_team: We'll run the serial mapping job at 09:00 UTC tomorrow and post the reconciliation CSV here. If there are mismatches we'll push corrected manifests to the vendor the same day.

raj_vendor_ops: Will also request vendor to pre-file corrected commercial invoice (HS codes & consignee VAT) to FRA customs for the remaining 20, should speed final clearance once serials are matched.

maria_ops: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here — need confirmation that 20 express AWBs booked and loaner pick scheduled before EOD PST. :thumbsup:
